newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine Jan-Aug GDP falls 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine Jan-Aug GDP falls 9.5 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's gross domestic product in the first eight months of this year was 9.5 percent lower than a year earlier, the Statistics Ministry said on Friday.
yr/yr pct change -9.5 pct -9.2 pct -12.4 pct

The government has forecast a GDP decline of no more than 1.5 percent this year, but Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko said it may be greater because of a grain harvest forecast at a poor 28 million tonnes.
The 1997 draft budget calls for GDP growth of 1.7 percent next year. GDP dropped 11.8 percent in 1995.
